snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 Outfit Preview: Dust-Shrouded Crime
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 Outfit Preview: Dust-Shrouded Crime

Newborn justice took the shape of the Golden Wing. Beneath its gaze, civilization flowed, then fell to ruin...
As the Code of Law quietly lost its golden glow, one heart alone remained untainted, and that was enough for light to raise fallen justice once more.

Main Attribute: Sexy
Outfit Ability: Golden Sight
After using the Golden Sight ability, Nikki activates Golden Wing's View to search for and mark Whimstars and Dews of Inspiration within a certain range in the open world. While the ability is being activated, use the [Jump] or [Dash] button to interrupt the current action. Once Golden Wing's View is active, using the [Ability] button again deactivates it. The animation for this ability can be enabled or disabled in Ability Setup.
While Golden Wing's View is active, the Whimstars and Dew of Inspiration around Nikki are highlighted, and markers appear on the map as well. Select the corresponding icon to track it; markers you are tracking will not disappear when Golden Wing's View is turned off. Once Golden Wing's View is activated, Nikki can switch to and use other abilities. Once activated, Golden Wing's View stays in effect until turned off manually. In the ability settings, you can choose to disable the special effect that plays when the ability is used.
After setting up the Golden Sight ability, the Concealment ability can be turned on or off. The Golden Wing flaps its wings, stirring up a cloud of dust around Nikki. The animation for this ability can be enabled or disabled in Ability Setup.
While under Concealment, Nikki cannot be detected by creatures, Esselings, or Behemoths in the open world. She can also activate Concealment during combat to disengage. While under Concealment, Nikki can switch to and use gathering abilities such as Bug-Catching, Fishing, and Animal-Grooming. This does not apply in Boss stages, the Realm of The Dark, the Realm of Breakthrough, or the Mira Crown Merit Arena.

Decoration: Above All Gold
Can be placed in open spaces. It was the grandest vision forged in the titans' golden age, singing with an ancient solitude of a radiance that had never dimmed through the long years.
❖ Available after reaching 160 Resonances in the limited-time Resonance "Gilded Judgment."

Evolution Rewards
◆ Evolving the outfit to Stage 1 unlocks the pose Golden Dawn Steps.
◆ Evolving the outfit to Stage 2 unlocks "Nestled in Gold" for Framed Moment. You can also use Dustbound Heartchime: Above All Gold on the [Clothing Evolution - Decoration: Radiance] screen to obtain the decoration Above All Gold: Radiance.
◆ Evolving the outfit to Stage 3 unlocks Echoes of Gold: Makeup, a new idle animation, multiple poses, enhanced outfit effects, and alternative details for certain pieces.

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.10 The Feather of Justice launches globally on September 23 (UTC-7)!
